question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.id_bioguide,
    l.gender,
    MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE))) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, l.gender
),
years_to_check AS (
  SELECT 0 as offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
time_points AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.id_bioguide,
    ft.gender,
    ft.first_term_year + y.offset as check_year,
    DATE('1970-01-01') + INTERVAL (ft.first_term_year + y.offset - 1970) YEAR + INTERVAL 11 MONTH + INTERVAL 30 DAY as check_date
  FROM first_term ft
  CROSS JOIN years_to_check y
  WHERE ft.first_term_year + y.offset <= 2025
),
serving AS (
  SELECT 
    tp.id_bioguide,
    tp.gender,
    tp.check_year,
    tp.check_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
      WHERE lt.id_bioguide = tp.id_bioguide 
      AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= tp.check_date 
      AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > tp.check_date
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_serving
  FROM time_points tp
),
with_state AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id_bioguide,
    s.gender,
    s.check_year,
    lt.state,
    s.is_serving
  FROM serving s
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = s.id_bioguide
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    gender,
    check_year,
    SUM(is_serving) as retained_count,
    COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM with_state
  GROUP BY state, gender, check_year
),
retention_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    gender,
    check_year,
    CAST(retained_count AS DOUBLE) / total_count as retention_rate
  FROM retention
  WHERE total_count > 0
),
females_all_years AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM retention_rate
  WHERE gender = 'F'
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT check_year) = 6
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 6
),
males_all_years AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM retention_rate
  WHERE gender = 'M'
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT check_year) = 6
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 6
)
SELECT fa.state
FROM females_all_years fa
JOIN males_all_years ma ON fa.state = ma.state
ORDER BY fa.state
